title: John Cage
idiom: Japanese ink wash / woodblock print — bridging Cage's Zen influences and the hand-drawn printmaking family the palace uses for people
hero_prompt: Wide darkfield composition in the style of Japanese ink wash painting and woodblock print — a piano with small objects (screws, bolts, pieces of rubber) resting between its strings, seen from above at an angle, surrounded by abstract marks suggesting ambient sound waves radiating outward like slow rings on water; the marks are calligraphic, incomplete, deliberate absences as much as strokes; deep black ink on off-white ground, a single pale wash suggesting a room's ambient light; no letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem: a single thick ink circle (the sound wave, the coin-throw, the hexagram ring) with two intersecting vertical strokes inside — minimal woodblock weight, black on cream; the circle is slightly imperfect, hand-drawn; no fine linework, no letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial; must read clearly at 24px
